short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.say: I don't care what's inside the box!
short_scenes.narration: Volt only cares how his amplifier's output responds to its input.
Treat it as a two port box. Open the output, push one ampere in, and measure: that's a Z parameter.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Four numbers describe the whole box.
